text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Gold City.
...Do you need anything besides my name?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I do modeling work, but
I'm at this academy to run.
With these legs... I want to show everyone my running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, treat me like a doll and I'll send you flying.
You'd better remember that.

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
